title: Spritzguss teile.jpg
author: Gmhofmann
used_as: Sh1-Sh2b (0-17.6 s): the four rings and the four-arm runner, cut out with GrabCut and animated as puppets. Sh4 (27.6-35.0 s): every rod of the eleven trees is a piece of this photograph's runner arms, straightened along their measured polylines, articulated as cutout trees, then melted into pieces that freeze into pellets. DECLARED COLOUR SUBSTITUTION: the photographed plastic is teal; its own shading is re-lit through a handmade red/amber thickness gel (plus a declared amber/orange tint in Sh4) because no openly licensed red or amber runner photograph was found. Its measured geometry also lays out the mould cavities (Sh3). Adaptations are CC BY-SA 4.0.
